description: Feedback testers sent from install pages and the in-app link, and on Team the TestFlight screenshot and crash feedback read from App Store Connect: bug reports, suggestions and other notes, newest first, with the source (page, app or testflight), the device, OS, build (and the TestFlight build) and how many screenshots or recordings came with it (open them in the dashboard link), and on Team the reply thread (team replies and tester answers). Read only.

blockers.description: Only reports marked as release blockers

build.description: Optional build id or install link slug

source.description: Only reports from the install page, the in-app link, or TestFlight (Team)
